index|downloads_added_at_id|CREATE INDEX downloads_added_at_id ON downloads (added_at, id)
--
index|downloads_category_id|CREATE INDEX downloads_category_id ON downloads (category_id)
--
index|downloads_state|CREATE INDEX downloads_state ON downloads (state)
--
index|servers_priority_name|CREATE INDEX servers_priority_name ON servers (priority, name)
--
index|sessions_user_id|CREATE INDEX sessions_user_id ON sessions (user_id)
--
table|app_key|CREATE TABLE app_key (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
    key        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (key <> ''),
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
) STRICT
--
table|categories|CREATE TABLE categories (
    id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    usenet_dir TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
, torrent_dir TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '') STRICT
--
table|download_sources|CREATE TABLE download_sources (
    download_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES downloads (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    nzb_path    TEXT NOT NULL,
    password    TEXT
) STRICT
--
table|downloads|CREATE TABLE downloads (
    id             TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name           TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_kind    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_kind IN ('nzb', 'torrent')),
    -- NULL when the Download has no Category.
    category_id    TEXT REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    state          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN (
                       'added', 'fetching_metadata', 'queued', 'fetching',
                       'fetched', 'post_processing', 'ready', 'failed')),
    priority       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal'
                       CHECK (priority IN ('force', 'high', 'normal', 'low')),
    queue_position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    paused         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (paused IN (0, 1)),
    -- NULL unless the Download failed.
    failure_reason TEXT CHECK (failure_reason IS NULL OR failure_reason IN (
                       'missing_articles', 'repair_insufficient', 'archive_unsupported',
                       'archive_password', 'archive_corrupt', 'disk_full',
                       'path_violation', 'source_invalid', 'internal')),
    failure_detail TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    total_bytes    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (total_bytes >= 0),
    done_bytes     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (done_bytes >= 0),
    added_at       INTEGER NOT NULL,
    fetched_at     INTEGER,
    ready_at       INTEGER,
    updated_at     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    output_path    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
) STRICT
--
table|schema_migrations|CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (
	version    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
	name       TEXT    NOT NULL,
	applied_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)
--
table|servers|CREATE TABLE servers (
    id              TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name            TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    host            TEXT NOT NULL,
    port            INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 563 CHECK (port BETWEEN 1 AND 65535),
    username        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    password        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    max_connections INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 8 CHECK (max_connections BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
    retention_days  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (retention_days >= 0),
    priority        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (priority >= 0),
    enabled         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (enabled IN (0, 1)),
    created_at      INTEGER NOT NULL
) STRICT
--
table|sessions|CREATE TABLE sessions (
    token_hash   BLOB PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(token_hash) = 32),
    user_id      TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    created_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    last_seen_at INTEGER NOT NULL
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID
--
table|settings|CREATE TABLE settings (
    key        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(value)),
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
) STRICT
--
table|torrent_pieces|CREATE TABLE torrent_pieces (
    info_hash   TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(info_hash) = 40),
    piece_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (piece_count BETWEEN 0 AND 4194304),
    bitmap      BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(bitmap) = (piece_count + 7) / 8),
    updated_at  INTEGER NOT NULL
) STRICT
--
table|torrent_sources|CREATE TABLE torrent_sources (
    download_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES downloads(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    info_hash    TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(info_hash) = 40),
    torrent_path TEXT NULL,
    magnet       TEXT NULL,
    created_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    CHECK (torrent_path IS NOT NULL OR magnet IS NOT NULL)
) STRICT
--
table|torrent_state|CREATE TABLE torrent_state (
    download_id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES downloads (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    uploaded              INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (uploaded >= 0),
    seeding_seconds       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (seeding_seconds >= 0),
    ratio_limit           REAL NULL,
    seeding_limit_seconds INTEGER NULL,
    moved                 INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (moved IN (0, 1)),
    location              TEXT NULL,
    updated_at            INTEGER NOT NULL
) STRICT
--
table|usenet_progress|CREATE TABLE usenet_progress (
    download_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES downloads (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    blob        BLOB NOT NULL,
    updated_at  INTEGER NOT NULL
) STRICT
--
table|usenet_reports|CREATE TABLE usenet_reports (
    download_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES downloads (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    missing_articles INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (missing_articles >= 0),
    missing_bytes    INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (missing_bytes >= 0),
    damaged_articles INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (damaged_articles >= 0),
    damaged_bytes    INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (damaged_bytes >= 0),
    missing_files    INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (missing_files >= 0),
    updated_at       INTEGER NOT NULL
) STRICT
--
table|usenet_undeferred|CREATE TABLE usenet_undeferred (
    download_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES downloads (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    file_index  INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (file_index >= 0),
    fetched     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (fetched IN (0, 1)),
    PRIMARY KEY (download_id, file_index)
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID
--
table|users|CREATE TABLE users (
    id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    username      TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    password_hash BLOB NOT NULL,
    created_at    INTEGER NOT NULL
) STRICT
--
